'''Pocket Monsters BW''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターBW''') is a shōnen [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Kosaku Anakubo]]. It is a sequel to the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]], [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]], {{OBP|Pocket Monsters DP|Kosaku Anakubo}} and {{OBP|Pocket Monsters HGSS|Kosaku Anakubo}} manga series and is succeeded by {{OBP|Pocket Monsters XY|Kosaku Anakubo}}. The plot follows the adventures of {{PPM|Red}} and his Pokémon as they travel to the [[Unova]] region. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.
